segments.name: Mass transit
segments.description: Provides mass transit through a dynamically-routed network of minibuses for consumers and businesses.
segments.evidence: We are a technology-driven disruptive mobility company that aims to provide reliable, safe, cost-effective and environmentally responsible mass transit solutions.

revenueModel.text: Riders pay a fixed rate per booked journey, and corporate, school and municipal customers pay per route for TaaS and cost-plus fees for SaaS.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers typically pay for our TaaS offerings on a per route basis, with pricing determined based on the length and location of such route and without regard to the number of riders on such route.
